notes: Read as a bare position clause ("a bare position clause mints no event whatever its verb"), so no rise event and the entity-attached surface head Above — defensible, though the stative-position verb list (lie/sit/stand/hang/lean/perch/rest) does not name extent/elevation verbs like rise/tower/loom, so the classification is a judgment the instruction set leaves implicit. The definite plural takes a group witness with the member-level position carried by the distribution rule (never on the group symbol), and the noun modifier of cliff_spire is correctly not exposed while the positional eastern is, un-derived.
